rules.common: Exactly equal and nonempty on every source row of the product.
rules.variant: Use common plus the selected row fields; never promote one shade to all shades.
rules.english: Not translated yet. Translate the verified source during integration; preserve qualifiers and inference markers.
rules.claims: Source claims are not independent certification. Do not render Inference as approved fact. Read claimDisclaimers and doNotSay before public copy.
